resources.string: You fly with %1$s today: invite your travel companions now, they won\'t be able to download AeroChat on the plane.
🎁 %1$s unlocked the Pass for the whole group until %2$s
No posts yet. Looking for a charger or want to share a snack? Write it here: people nearby will see it.
The cabin board: short posts visible to people nearby, for 6 hours at most.
Invalid post: 1 to 140 characters, no links.
You already have 3 open posts: close one to publish another.
E.g. a USB-C charger, snacks to share…
Looking for a seat swap: I\'m in %1$s.
Bluetooth is off. You can turn it back on in airplane mode: AeroChat works in flight too, with no network.
The radio is on and looking for people nearby.
Let\'s check together what\'s needed to find people with AeroChat near you.
Notifications are off: you won\'t know when someone says hi or writes to you.
We\'ll let you know when someone says hi or writes to you.
Without the nearby devices permission AeroChat can\'t see anyone.
Stay within 30 metres, with only a few seats in between: Bluetooth doesn\'t pass well through bodies and luggage.
The other person must have AeroChat open (at least once after turning the phone on).
Both of you should update AeroChat to the latest version before you leave.
Nobody on your flight has shared their seat yet. Share yours to appear on the map.
Join the flight Cabin with your boarding pass to see the seat map.
Row and letter, as on your boarding pass (e.g. 14C). Leave empty to clear it.
Invalid seat: a row number (1–999) and a letter from A to K, e.g. 14C.
Your seat counts in the flight Cabin: add your boarding pass to use it.
Would you like to swap seats?
Would you like to swap seats? I\'m in %1$s.
Show my seat to people nearby
Only passengers on your own flight see your seat. Off by default.
Chat with people on board even out at sea, with no roaming or paid Wi-Fi.
At the festival with no signal
When the network collapses in the crowd, messages hop from phone to phone.
In the mountains with no coverage
Stay in touch with your hiking group even where your phone has no signal.
Write to people nearby without mobile data and translate messages with no internet.
Press and hold a message and choose \"Translate\": your phone\'s translator opens. Download the languages in the translator first (e.g. Google Translate) to use it without internet.
Do it now, while there\'s a network: they won\'t be able to download AeroChat on the plane.
Free game 🎁 You get one a day and one per flight; after that you need the Pass.
Location unavailable: turn on location and try again outdoors.
In flight, the crew is your first point of contact.
Alert the crew first: use the call button above your seat. Send the alert to the whole cabin?

resources.string: When 3 new friends join with your QR code or link, you get 24 hours of Pass for free (just for you, once).
Invite reward already earned: thanks for bringing your friends on board!
Invite Pass active until %1$s (just for you)
3 friends joined with your invite: the Pass is active for 24 hours on this phone. It can\'t be gifted to groups.
Google Play opens to redeem the code: you need an internet connection.
Android: you can pass the app on without internet using Quick Share. Open the Play Store › your profile › Manage apps & device › Share apps, then pick AeroChat and the nearby phone.
iPhone: apps can\'t be installed without internet. AeroChat must be downloaded before boarding.
Numbers from all your flights with AeroChat, updated at the end of each flight. They stay on this phone only.
